title: NISM Series VIII - Equity Derivatives Certification Exam
description: This exam assesses the knowledge and understanding of equity derivatives products, their uses, and the regulatory framework surrounding them. Our NISM Equity Derivatives Mock Test cover topics such as futures, options, trading strategies, risk management, and more.

title: NISM Series V A - Mutual Fund Distributors Certification Exam
description: This certification is mandatory for individuals engaged in selling, marketing, or distributing mutual funds. Our NISM Mutual Fund Mock Test cover topics such as mutual fund basics, types of mutual funds, regulatory framework, sales and distribution practices, and investor services.

title: NISM Series VI - Depository Operations Certification Exam
description: This exam focuses on assessing the knowledge and understanding of individuals working in depository operations. Our NISM Depository Mock Test cover topics such as depository systems, depository participants, dematerialization, rematerialization, corporate actions, and more.

title: NISM Series X A - Investment Adviser (Level 1) Certification Exam
description: This certification is designed for individuals providing investment advisory services. Our mock tests for NISM Series X A cover topics such as investment advisory regulations, ethical practices, risk profiling, asset allocation, investment products, and financial planning.
